bibliographic.title: Almost Lover (Jam Version)
bibliographic.author: Sanadi
bibliographic.description:
You have just found your target in a bar.
Break your heart over an old friend who has become a mission.

A 500 words linearTwine story about  duty and delivering the final death.
Even if it hurts.

Possible content warnings: mentions of implied drinking (by others), vampire death (dust involved), suggestive themes (neck kissing), bad flirting, and (eventually) mentioned crying.

(This version is what I remade after losing half the work because I foolishly used the Web editor.  Always  do your backups!)
